item.title: Ladakh set to emerge as India’s Sea Buckthorn Capital, says LG Kavinder
item.description: Says new Centre of Excellence to boost Ladakh’s Rural Economy PM Modi’s vision for sea buckthorn development takes shape in Ladakh Asks youth to harness opportunities and play role in region’s economic growth Ladakh youth should become job creators, not job seekers Leh, December 4: Ladakh has the potential to emerge as India’s Sea Buckthorn Capital, owing to its vast natural reserves, favourable high-altitude conditions, and its status as the largest sea buckthorn–growing region in the country.

item.title: CBK chargesheets “Chronic Offender” in high-value Dubai Export Scam
item.description: DEC 6: Chronic offender Zahid Bashir Shagoo has been booked again by the EOW, CBK, in FIR 31/2023 for a high-value Dubai export scam. Shagoo, along with co-accused Javeed Ah Shah, allegedly duped a victim into investing ₹34.74 lakh in a fake mutton and rice export business. The accused reportedly used forged agreements, fake documents, and staged trips to Punjab and Dubai to create credibility. Both Shagoo and Shah remain absconding, with the chargesheet filed in absentia under Section 512 CrPC.
